L7·N6248unmasked layer
This neuron has no clean lexical trigger — it fires weakly on ordinary mid-sentence content words in plain descriptive/web prose ("give", "finished", "certain", "Sahara", "falls", "on"), and is strongly suppressed in code/technical-identifier contexts (function names, script talk, sub-word splits like "-b|odies", "Pars|eltongue"), so it looks like a diffuse prose-vs-code context feature rather than a token detector.
